release_notes: Company and sector now fill in automatically on the Farm, Dealer and Market forms instead of showing as unresolved. They are worked out from your own zone rather than typed in by hand, so a record is always filed under the right company. Pick the Existing dealer option and the dealer list now shows your real dealers from the sales system, and choosing one fills in the contact person, phone and address it already holds. Farms now ask for a phone number, and each farm must have its own number so it can be found again later. The ERP dealer box has been taken off the farm form, and the web reports for Markets, Dealers and Farms now show the zone, company and sector names.
